files.purpose: Pure decision: which scene follows a finished match.
Match-scene MonoBehaviour: stores the result on MatchEnded, holds, then loads Victory (or Start).

integration_notes: Add the MatchFlow component to a GameObject in Match.unity (default execution order; not under MatchBootstrap's order).
Tune 'Knockout Hold Seconds' in the Inspector (default 1.5).
RuralRumble.UI.asmdef must reference RuralRumble.Match (MatchBootstrap) in addition to Core/Combat; the Match assembly must not reference UI.
The EditMode test assembly needs a reference to RuralRumble.UI and RuralRumble.Core.
Add Victory to Build Settings once it exists; until then MatchFlow falls back to Start (which must be in Build Settings).
assumptions: CombatEvents lives in namespace RuralRumble.Combat, referenced as Combat.CombatEvents from within RuralRumble.UI (resolves to RuralRumble.Combat).
MatchEnded fires at most once, but a guard still prevents a double load.
The hold is unscaled time as requested; combat freezing is Combat's job, so Time.timeScale is untouched.
